title: E0090: File write to user-controlled path
plain_english: Using user input to determine a file path for writing can allow an attacker to write files to arbitrary locations on the server.
why_matters: Arbitrary file writes can: - Overwrite critical system or application files - Drop a web shell for remote code execution - Modify configuration files to weaken security
what_it_checks: `file_put_contents()`, `file()`, and `fopen()` with `'w'`, `'w+'`, `'a'`, or `'a+'` modes where the path is built from user-controlled input
